page_title: BOC 0-2 MON | Bochum v B. Monchengladbach 31/08/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' Soren Storks is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) fires the ball at goal from inside the area, but it's well blocked.
89' The referee is firm and issues Mats Pannewig (Bochum) a deserved yellow card.

88' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a beautiful cross from the side, but the opposition defence is ready and one of the defenders averts the threat with a quick interception.
87' Gerardo Seoane has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Stefan Lainer (B. Monchengladbach) replacing Luca Netz.
86' Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach) fires a strong shot to the middle of the goal and the save is unexpectedly difficult for Patrick Drewes.
84' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) decided to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick shot from the edge of the box, but his effort crashes against the crossbar.
82' Substitution. Tim Kleindienst will be replaced by Tomas Cvancara (B. Monchengladbach).
82' Franck Honorat will be replaced by Nathan Ngoumou (B. Monchengladbach).
81' Here is a change. Jakov Medic is going off and Peter Zeidler gives the last tactical orders to Tim Oermann (Bochum).
81' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Ibrahima Sissoko leaves the pitch and Mats Pannewig (Bochum) comes on.
78' 0 - 2 Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
77' Aliou Balde (Bochum) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
75' Lukas Daschner (Bochum) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
74' Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
73' The ball possession at the moment is 37:63.
72' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) takes the corner kick and sends the ball among a huddle of players inside the penalty area, but one of the defenders clears it to safety.

69' Julian Weigl (B. Monchengladbach) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the left side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one! Corner kick. B. Monchengladbach will have an opportunity.
69' A cross from Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
68' That's the end of the game for Philipp Sander, who is replaced by Robin Hack (B. Monchengladbach).
68' Gerardo Seoane has decided to substitute Alassane Plea and he is replaced by Rocco Reitz (B. Monchengladbach).
67' 0 - 1 Tim Kleindienst (B. Monchengladbach) leaps to connect with a delightful cross and places his sweet header into the roof of the net. The goalkeeper had no chance to make a save.
65' Philipp Hofmann comes off the pitch to be replaced by Lukas Daschner (Bochum).
65' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post.
64' The Bochum players are exchanging some short passes.
61' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bochum.
61' Dangerous play by Luca Netz (B. Monchengladbach). Soren Storks blows his whistle for a foul. Bochum are awarded the free kick.
60' Felix Passlack (Bochum) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
58' The linesman signals a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
56' A defence splitting pass into the box is almost received by Aliou Balde (Bochum), but Jonas Omlin is quick enough and comes off his line to intercept the pass.
53' The total number of attempts is 8:9.
52' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) has a goal ruled out for offside!
50' B. Monchengladbach have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
50' Half-chance! Philipp Sander (B. Monchengladbach) plays a pass into the box, but Patrick Drewes reacts well to snuff out the attack.
50' The yellow card is received by Mats Pannewig (Bochum).

49' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety.
47' Aliou Balde (Bochum) races through the centre to the edge of the box then lets fly with a rocket of a shot that flies a whisker wide of the right post.
46' Peter Zeidler prepares a substitution. Anthony Losilla is replaced by Myron Boadu (Bochum).
46' Here is a change after the half-time break. Moritz Broschinski is replaced by Aliou Balde (Bochum).
46' The second half has just started.
45+2' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+2' Alassane Plea (B. Monchengladbach) is disappointed with himself because he got into a good area but produced a poor cross.
45' 1 additional min. will be played.
42' The corner is swung in but B. Monchengladbach can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
41' Foul! Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) is penalised for pulling back his opponent. A free kick to B. Monchengladbach.
37' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
35' Soren Storks interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum). A free kick is awarded to B. Monchengladbach.
32' A cross by Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) from the side of the pitch flies into the box, but fails to find its intended target as the aim was poor.
31' Kevin Stoger (B. Monchengladbach) moves forward and unleashes a thunderous shot from distance that flies well over the bar.
28' The resulting set piece from B. Monchengladbach is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
27' The referee and the linesman both signal a throw-in for B. Monchengladbach.
24' The referee signals a free kick. Bochum are going to take it from long range.
22' Soren Storks blows his whistle and it's Joe Scally (B. Monchengladbach) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Bochum have a free kick.
17' 40:60 – the ratio of ball possession.
16' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) lets fly with a decent effort from the edge of the box that flashes just wide of the right post.
13' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger.
11' A pass into the penalty area from Anthony Losilla (Bochum) is intercepted by the defence.
10' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) is unable to control an accurate defence-splitting pass properly and one of the defending players reacts well to rob him of the ball.
8' Ibrahima Sissoko (Bochum) guides an effort goalwards from the edge of the box, but it sails just wide of the left post.
6' Maximilian Wittek (Bochum) whips a long ball in from the free kick which is intercepted by Jonas Omlin.
5' Franck Honorat (B. Monchengladbach) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.

4' Philipp Hofmann (Bochum) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! Free kick. B. Monchengladbach will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
2' B. Monchengladbach are ruled offside.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Bochum will kick the game off.
The referee of today's match will be Soren Storks.
